home.heroSub: SafeHaven is a mission-critical personal protection platform providing real-time SOS distress broadcasting, live GPS telemetry, and automated priority emergency dispatch.
home.tapToTrigger: Tap button to open distress transmission sequence.
home.capabilitiesSub: Core safety mechanics engineered for minimal latency and high availability.
home.cap1Desc: Dispatches multi-channel distress alerts containing real-time GPS coordinates to your 5 designated priority emergency contacts.
home.cap2Desc: Store and manage emergency contacts with custom relationship tags, speed-dial links, and priority SMS notification rules.
home.cap3Desc: Comprehensive tactical self-defense strategies, travel security checklists, digital privacy guidelines, and legal rights handbook.

hotlines.nationalDesc: Toll-free national emergency response center for police, fire & ambulance.
hotlines.policeDesc: Direct emergency dispatch for police assistance and crime reporting.
hotlines.womenDesc: 24/7 dedicated helpline for women and child security & legal support.
hotlines.shasthyoDesc: 24/7 government health helpline for medical advice from registered doctors, hospital info, and ambulance listings.

safetyTools.fakeCallDesc: Simulate a realistic incoming phone call to safely excuse yourself from uncomfortable situations.
safetyTools.medicalIdSub: Vital health telemetry for emergency responders & paramedics.
safetyTools.voiceSub: Captures background audio telemetry for legal evidence
safetyTools.cameraSub: Record video clips & snapshot evidence during emergencies
safetyTools.launchCamera: Click to Launch Live Camera Feed
safetyTools.cameraDesc: Captures timestamped photo snapshots & video evidence
safetyTools.noMedia: No photo or video evidence stored yet.

auth.resetSub: Enter your registered email address to receive password recovery instructions.

dashboard.subText: Emergency telemetry active. Priority emergency contact(s) linked to your SOS beacon.
dashboard.tapToTrigger: Tap button to trigger immediate SOS signal dispatch.

sos.sosActiveSub: Distress signal has been sent. Emergency contacts and command center have received your live location.

footer.desc: Mission-critical personal safety platform providing distress broadcasting, continuous telemetry tracking, and rapid hotline routing.
footer.security: Location telemetry is encrypted end-to-end and transmitted solely during authorized SOS distress events to designated emergency contacts.
